description: This Java class implements a specific command strategy for retrieving a subject within a policies persistence context. It handles the RetrieveSubject command, searches for the relevant policy entry and subject, and constructs an appropriate response or error result.

classes.name: RetrieveSubjectStrategy
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractPolicyQueryCommandStrategy to handle RetrieveSubject commands, executing policy and subject lookups and returning appropriate results.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the core logic for retrieving a subject from a policy based on the command, performing checks and returning a result or error if not found.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Generates the next entity tag for the retrieved entity, useful for versioning and concurrency control.
